title: FRIDAY ARMS + CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. OPEN THE CHEST AND HIPS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT PUSH, PULL, AND SHORT SIDE BRACES. FLEXIBILITY WOVEN IN. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. SIXTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE CHEST AND HIPS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT PUSH, PULL, AND SHORT SIDE BRACES. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE DONE. CHEST OPEN. HIPS HONEST. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: STANDING CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. HANDS BEHIND YOU OR ON THE DOOR FRAME. GENTLY OPEN THE CHEST. SHOULDER BLADES EASY. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT FORCE IT.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING CHEST OPENERS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. OPEN THE CHEST. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT FORCE IT LIKE YOU ARE PRIZING OPEN A BLOODY STUCK WINDOW.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE-FOUR STRETCH
exercises.cue: SIT TALL ON THE FLOOR OR A CHAIR. ANKLE ON THE OPPOSITE KNEE. GENTLY HINGE OR DRAW THE THIGH IN UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP. BREATHE. HIP OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SEATED FIGURE FOUR STRETCHES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE ON THE KNEE. EASE INTO THE OUTER HIP. THIS IS YOUR HIP OPENER. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE WRENCHING A BLOODY RUSTY BOLT.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. ONE FOOT OFF THE FLOOR. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. LIGHT FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. EYES FORWARD. OWN IT.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG STANDS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH LEG. ONE FOOT UP. SOFT KNEE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TOPPLE LIKE A BLOODY DRUNK AT CLOSING TIME.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SWITCH LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STEP. ABOUT FORTY INCHES. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER CHEST TOWARD THE STEP. PRESS UP CLEAN. LIGHT STRENGTH. DO NOT DROP THE STEP HEIGHT.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER AND PRESS. LIGHT STRENGTH. DO NOT CHEAT THE HEIGHT LIKE A BLOODY TAX DODGER.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: BENT-OVER SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: SOFT HINGE. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. ELBOWS DRIVE TO THE HIPS. HOLD A BEAT. LIGHT PULL WORK. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: BENT OVER SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. SOFT HINGE. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. LIGHT PULL WORK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A BLOODY LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. FOREARM UNDER THE SHOULDER. HIPS UP. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. SHORT AND HONEST. BUILD TOWARD LONGER LATER.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. HIPS UP. SHORT HOLDS. WE BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
